title: SessionMetadata
description: P1a session record (SW-20260915-002 §8.9). home_zone_id is written once by the authenticated ingress/policy and is immutable afterwards; the canonical store is the Nexus SessionStore. Semantics derive from ADR-001 (Proposed) §3.1; the P1a subset is recorded in contracts/manifests/runtime-v2-p1a-amendment.json — not a freeze.

home_zone_id.description: Immutable: Session metadata/Transcript/Context/Artifact/Verify records default-write into this zone.

agent_principal.description: Opaque agent principal reference (ADR-001 AgentPrincipalRef carried as an opaque string in the P1a subset).

task_ids.description: P1a records the gap explicitly when Tasks are not yet introduced; the field stays empty rather than fabricating records.
